name: Repro Pack
description: Turns a bug report, a playtest session or a QA pass into a repro pack: exact steps, environment, expected versus actual, evidence (screenshots, console and network notes), a severity call and a minimal reproduction a developer can run first time. Use when the user asks to reproduce a bug, confirm a report, playtest a build or page, run an exploratory QA pass, or write up an issue for developers. Do NOT use for writing automated test suites (use e2e-test-architect) or for fixing the code (use debug-production-issue).
